# Health Travel Aggregator

> A curated marketplace for medical tourism — clinics, treatments, packages, and verified reviews.

## Overview

The Health Travel Aggregator connects patients with accredited clinics and treatment packages across borders. Providers publish clinics, treatments, and all-inclusive packages; patients search, compare, and request quotes; admins moderate listings and reviews.

## Stack

- Backend: Rust workspace (`service/`) with SQLite storage
- Frontend: Nuxt 4 (`web/`) with Vue 3, Tailwind CSS, and Vite+
- Deployment: systemd + Caddy

## Key Features

- Clinic and provider profiles with accreditation details
- Treatment and package catalogs with transparent pricing
- Location-based search and filtering
- Quote request / inquiry flow for patients
- Verified reviews and admin moderation queue
- SEO-friendly pages, sitemap, and structured data

## API Endpoints

- `GET /healthz` — Health check
- `GET /api/v1/clinics?limit=50` — List clinics
- `GET /api/v1/clinics/:id` — Clinic detail
- `GET /api/v1/packages?limit=50` — List packages
- `GET /api/v1/packages/:id` — Package detail
- `POST /api/v1/inquiries` — Submit a quote request

## Pages

- `/` — Home page with search and featured listings
- `/about` — About the platform
- `/sitemap.xml` — XML sitemap for crawlers

## Contact

- Website: https://health-travel.lucanian.app
